verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline and a large, clear CTA. But the CTA sits at the far left, so it reads before the headline. The 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon has shrunk to an illegible chip jammed against the subhead. The legal copy on the right is as large as the subhead and competes with the logo and the tiny bottle. B has a strong centred headline, but the CTA is buried as a tiny pill in a cramped left column, under an illegible sale ribbon and a small logo. The fine print is set almost at subhead size, and the bottle is pushed against the right edge, which leaves the layout lopsided.
